name: ManagedClusterSetBinding
description: Projects a ManagedClusterSet into a specific namespace, enabling workloads in that namespace to be scheduled to clusters within the set.
usageHint: Use this to bind a ManagedClusterSet into a namespace. Required for workloads in that namespace to access clusters in the set.

spec.clusterSet: string (name of the ManagedClusterSet to bind; must match the resource name)
